text.en: ConvMixer is row 9 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: ConvMixer 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 9 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates ConvMixer with “Patches Are All You Need?”.
text.zh: 年度表把 ConvMixer 与论文《Patches Are All You Need?》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Asher Trockman, J. Zico Kolter”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Asher Trockman（官方页拼写）、J. Zico Kolter（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Asher Trockman, J. Zico Kolter”。
